I received an email from my credit monitoring service that informed me that my credit profile was adversely impacted. I found that ZIONS DEBT HOLDINGS had illegally posted an alleged collection account to my credit report. I have never started nor an opened account with this company. My report shows that ZIONS DEBT HOLDINGS open account was opened on XX/XX/2022 with a balance of {$1000.00}. By federal law, a debt collector is supposed to make contact with an alleged debtor and give them 30 days to validate or dispute before they move forward with collection attempts. I never received a letter in the mail that gave me 30 days to validate or dispute this account. I never received a letter stating that I have an alleged debt with this company and owe a balance on that account. I, a consumer defined under 15 USC 1692a ( 3 ), understand that, under the FDCPA guidelines for collection agencies, they have to provide ( XXXX ) legitimate proof that they are the original holder of this debt and can legally hold me responsible for paying this debt and ( XXXX ) contractual proof of obligation or an assignment SIGNED from an XXXX from the original creditors corporation that I am supposed to pay them. 15 USC 1692g Sec. 809 ( b ) of the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act ( FDCPA ) grants me the right as a consumer to request validation of this alleged debt they say I owe. I fully understand 1692g. Validation of debts ( a ) Notice of debt ; that states within five days after the initial communication with a consumer in connection with the collection of any debt, a debt collector shall, unless the following information is contained in the initial communication or the consumer has paid the debt, send the consumer a written notice containing ( 1 ) the amount of the debt ; ( 2 ) the name of the creditor to whom the debt is owed ; ( 3 ) a statement that unless the consumer, within thirty days after receipt of the notice, disputes the validity of the debt, or any portion thereof, the debt will be assumed to be valid by the debt collector ; ( 4 ) a statement that if the consumer notifies the debt collector in writing within the thirty-day period that the debt, or any portion thereof, is disputed, the debt collector will obtain verification of the debt or a copy of a judgment against the consumer and a copy of such verification or judgment will be mailed to the consumer by the debt collector ; and ( XXXX ) a statement that, upon the consumer 's written request within the thirty-day period, the debt collector will provide the consumer with the name and address of the original creditor, if different from the current creditor. ( b ) Disputed debts - If the consumer notifies the debt collector in writing within the thirty-day period described in subsection ( a ) of this section that the debt, or any portion thereof, is disputed, or that the consumer requests the name and address of the original creditor, the debt collector shall cease collection of the debt, or any disputed portion thereof, until the debt collector obtains verification of the debt or a copy of a judgment, or the name and address of the original creditor, and a copy of such verification or judgment, or name and address of the original creditor, is mailed to the consumer by the debt collector. ( c ) Admission of liability - The failure of a consumer to dispute the validity of a debt under this section may not be construed by any court as an admission of liability by the consumer. I never received a notice of right to dispute nor did I receive any information to verify that the alleged debt with this company belonged to me. If I would have gotten anything in the mail from this company before they illegally reported to my credit report, I would have respectfully requested evidence that I am the person they are asking to pay this debt and a contractual obligation that legally binds me to pay them this debt. Upon them receiving my validation letter by certified mail with return receipt, they would have to legally cease from collection calls, letters, and efforts and delete the account from my credit reports until they can validate this debt. But again, I never received such a letter about this account ever in the mail because it was never sent. In order for them to prove that I received it properly, the proper letter should have been mailed certified mail with return receipt or by some form of proof of tracking that would require my signature. And if the company did mail anything to me, where is the legal proof of tracking or my signature stating that I received it? Where is the return receipt or postage signature showing that I received it and signed for it? But again, I never received any sort of mail or package. 
They have illegally posted and reported to my credit file without adhering to the FDCPA laws. XXXX not sure if this company is a scam, but I know that this company has broken FCRA and FDCPA laws by reporting an alleged account to my credit report without informing me through mail and I did not receive notice of right to dispute nor did I receive any information to verify that the alleged debt belonged to me. My credit has dropped tremendously in the middle of making home renovations. Please help me get this account removed immediately. As a consumer, XXXX publicly publishing this descriptive complaint on www.consumerfinance.gov so that others can learn from my experience and so that this government agency can use this information to help work with other violations and complaints from consumers regarding this company. Under 12 CFR Part 1006 and as a consumer defined under 15 USC 1692a ( 3 ), I'm also preparing to sue under the FCRA and FDCPA because of the numerous consumer law violations committed by this company, damages to my credit and opportunity costs with making a major purchase, and business ventures that must be delayed until this illegal account is removed. It should not be my responsibility to submit proof that this debt does not belong to me. It is the responsibility of the debt collector to submit proof that they can legally collect on the alleged debt, legally report to the credit agencies, and follow all FCRA and FDCPA. As of this date, they have failed to do so. ZIONS DEBT HOLDINGS XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX

This complaint is filed as a first attempt to get the sum of {$4700.00} and {$550.00} ( Total {$5200.00} ) refunded, after discovering the Companys Predatory Lending Tactics during the Loan application process. 

I am currently under contract with XXXX XXXX for a new construction XXXX XXXX scheduled to close XXXX XX/XX/XXXX. This will be my first time home purchase. Upon intent to proceed, I was asked to pay an earnest money deposit of 6 % of Home Cost ( {$28000.00} ) towards the home. The seller also advertised having a seller credit of {$28000.00} added to closing cost if I went with the preferred Mortgage company NVR Mortgage. In the event I did not go with NVR I do not receive the seller credit. The offer Sounded great, and I decided to proceed with a Loan application. An additional {$550.00} was sent for the Home Appraisal, bringing total funds credited to {$29000.00}. 

Even with my really good credit, the Loan officer kept pushing for an XXXX XXXXXXXX. I later found out reason was to enable easier access to extort funds. 

Meetings were held with the Loan officer to go over the numbers, and the interest rates were locked in very early on in the process in XX/XX/XXXX. Per the loan officer, the company had a program that will help the buyer lock in a different rate in the event interest rates go down closer to the closing date. This option was called XXXX XXXX which is a 1 % fee of the total purchase price. The fee amounted to {$4700.00}. I was told I could transfer funds from my earnest money down to the XXXX XXXX account, but will need to provide written confirmation. I was also informed that in the event I dont utilize the XXXX XXXX, I will have the money go towards my down payment. Sounded straight forward, so I provided the confirmation email and signed the XXXX XXXX papers without thorough review, believe I was working with an honest company. 

As the process went by, I was uncomfortable with the numbers provided, and decided to do proper research and cross check each estimate. Upon researching and now having gained better knowledge of the home purchase process, I discovered NVR was inflating my costs to close, excluding lender credits, reducing amount of deposit made, reducing what my percentage for a down payment of an XXXX loan is, including costs for a premium mortgage insurance to my seller costs and also including same amount to the amount being loaned ( double charges ), including Transfer Taxes to my cost, however contract with seller states that the State Transfer taxes will be paid for by the seller. All these issues raised Red Flags, and my questions left unclearly answered, hence my decision to not proceed with NVR as my Mortgage Lender. The explanation for the discrepancies was said to be due to how the company system is set to operate, which I knew was False. As the explaining was them going in circles. I was also informed I will Forfeit the fees for the float down if I withdraw my Loan application. Unfortunately, the XXXX XXXX addendum had that clause indicated, but I did not anticipate not moving forward with NVR as I assumed I was in good hands. 

I intend to pursue to all extent possible to receive my funds back, as the breach was on the part of NVR providing False estimates, double charging and inflating costs and trying to extort additional funds from a First Time Home Buyer. The cost estimates provided show it all. ( a total of XXXX estimates are attached ) This has made an experience that should have been good, quite painful and hurtful. 

Below is a break down of issues noted. 

* A. FINAL LOAN AMOUNT HAS UPFRONT MORTGAGE INSURANCE PREMIUM INCLUDED ( IN ALL ESTIMATES PROVIDED ), HOWEVER THAT AMOUNT IS NOT INCLUDED IN Closing cost financed by lender section OF THE CLOSING COST SHEET, INSTEAD MY DOWN PAYMENT FIGURES ARE MANIPULATED.Home price is {$470000.00}, after 3.5 % amount is {$460000.00}. With Upfront premium mortgage insurance added amount goes up to {$460000.00}. However Lender fails to include the premium mortgage insurance being lended to the total costs. 


* B. DOWN PAYMENT AMOUNT FOR XXXX FHA LOAN IS 3.5 % OF THE TOTAL PURCHASE PRICE, WHICH IN MY CASE IS {$16000.00}, HOWEVER DOWN PAYMENT IS NOT LISTED AS 3.5 % ON ALL ESTIMATES PROVIDED. IT IS LISTED AS {$8600.00}. ( 1.75 % ) In order words intentionally reducing my down payment, having me pay for the upfront mortgage insurance, but still including the upfront mortgage insurance in my loan amount. 

* C. MY DEPOSIT FOR THIS HOME IS {$28000.00}. IN A RECENT ESTIMATE SHEET PROVIDED ( XX/XX/XXXX ), THE SUM OF {$24000.00} IS INDICATED AS MY DEPOSIT ( per XXXX reason was because that is what is reflecting on XXXX XXXX end due to the reallocation of funds for the XXXX XXXX option, ) HOWEVER XXXX FAILED TO INCLUDE THE FUNDS OF {$4700.00} IN THE SHEET UNDER OTHER CREDITS ( Which inflates my total cost due ) * D. TRANSFER TAXES : TRANSFER TAXES FEES DONT ADD UP : MD STATE TRANSFER TAXES IS 0.5 %. For a first time home buyer this is discounted to 0.25 % in which the seller is paying that amount. ( as confirmed in the contract ) All other Transfer Tax and Fees have First Time Home Buyer exemptions, however cost estimate has entire amount indicated for the buyer ( myself to pay ) * PERFORMING AN APPRAISAL ON A HOUSE NOT HALF WAY COMPLETE, EVEN AFTER SENDING AN EMAIL TO WITHDRAW THE LOAN APPLICATION. 


These Predatory Practices are appalling and people need to be protected.

I hope this letter finds you well. I am writing to bring to your attention a matter concerning my mortgage account with this bank. During the COVID-19 pandemic, I experienced significant financial instability, which led me to seek assistance from the bank in adjusting my payment plan. Despite multiple attempts to contact the bank, I did not receive any response, rendering me unable to afford the high payments at the time. 
It was only after the COVID-19 pandemic had subsided that I received a response from the bank. Subsequently, we were able to establish a new payment plan, and since then, I have consistently made timely payments, with no further instances of late payments. However, I have noticed that the late payments incurred during the pandemic have not been removed from my credit report. 
I understand the importance of accurate credit reporting, and I believe that the presence of these late payments on my credit report does not accurately reflect my current financial situation and payment history. I kindly request your assistance in reviewing this matter and facilitating the removal of the late payments from my credit report, considering the extenuating circumstances surrounding the COVID-19 pandemic and the subsequent resolution with the bank.

I emailed the research assistant on XX/XX/2023 and let her know I never received a gift card. She emailed me back and told me that around XX/XX/2023 they were having issues with the Vanilla Visa website. She said the website was sending multiple cards to 1 email address and none to the email addresses she had been trying to send them to. 

She then sent me a {$50.00} electronic Vanilla Visa on XX/XX/XXXX. When I opened it and tried to activate it, I discovered it was already active, and the card had been drained down to about a {$9.00} balance. I contacted the research assistant again, explained what had happened and sent her a screenshot of the drained Vanilla Visa card. She sent me a replacement on XX/XX/XXXX. 

The same thing occurred with the replacement card. The balance was drained to about {$9.00}. I started comparing both cards and XXXX InComm Financial, Vanilla Visa, etc. I suspect the day the research assistant was having problems on the vanilla visa website and all the cards were going to one email address, the site may have been spoofed or hacked. All of the charges on both of the Vanilla Visas I had been sent, were dated between XX/XX/XXXX and XX/XX/XXXX even though the cards had not been sent to me until XX/XX/XXXX and XX/XX/XXXX. 

InComm makes it difficult to get your money back after one of these scams. 
I was on the phone for over an hour trying to deal with the XXXX {$50.00} cards I was given from the study. The first customer service representative hung up on me while taking my fraud report. I had to verbally provide information for the representative to start a separate dispute ticket for each card. 

This was entered into a dispute ticket form and then emailed to me for review. Both tickets had errors, so I could not electronically sign those tickets. I had to send an email notifying them of the errors and wait for the errors to be fixed before I could sign the tickets, which would then open a dispute case for each Vanilla Visa. I am still waiting for the corrections to be made and as a result, no fraud tickets have been opened.

So, InComm seems to use the same tactics to avoid accountability. I was told that it could take up to several months for them to complete their investigation. I spent hours reading about Vanilla Visa and those cards have multiple lawsuits pending against them. It seems to be well known that those cards are hacked and drained often, and it takes forever to try and recover the money if your card was drained. 

Honestly, what kind of company allows these despicable issues to drag out for months without addressing them ASAP.

On XX/XX/XXXX I attempted to charge the card for the {$100.00} and the charge was declined. I logged on to the american express balance website and saw that the available balance was {$99.00}. I did not understand what the XXXX discrepancy was since the card had been sealed and unused until now but dismissed this. 

I attempted to charge the card for {$99.00}. It was declined. 

I then successfully charged the card for {$50.00}. I then rechecked the american express balance and saw that the credit card had been debited for {$57.00}. In addition, there was the XXXX debit as a separate transaction on this day that I do not understand at all. 
A screenshot of the AMEX transactions from their balance inquiry site is included in the attached document. 

I called the merchant- XXXX XXXX who confirmed that their transaction amount was for {$50.00} and no fees were added. A screenshot of the transaction from the XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX is included in the attached document. 

I reviewed the disclosure that was included with the card and saw no transaction fee. I googled this and found no additional information. Pictures of the disclosure included is included in the attached document. 


I called the american express customer service number shown on the card XXXX and found that none of the menu options addressed this and there was no option to be connected to a representative. 

I called a customer service number from the american express website for credit cards. XXXX XX/XX/XXXX XXXX ET. I was able to reach a representative since I did have an open amex card. The rep name was XXXX. I explained the situation and how upset with this experience I was, and she attempted to help by calling the gift card department internally. Complaint Regarding Credit Report Inaccuracies Dear CFPB, I am writing to file a complaint regarding inaccurate information on my credit report. I have been actively disputing these inaccuracies with the credit bureaus, but they have failed to adequately investigate my claims or remove the incorrect information. In accordance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act. I attached the PDF file below containing the list of items that have violated my federally protected consumer rights to privacy and confidentiality under 15 USC 1681. 

Credit Bureau stated everything was complete and accurate. But how is that possible if the open date, date of last activity and much more is incorrect. According to 15 USC 1681i ( 5 ), they are supposed to modify or delete accounts that aren't reporting correctly. 

15 U.S.C. 1681s-2 ( A ) ( 1 ) A person shall not furnish any information relating to a consumer to any consumer reporting agency if the person knows or has reasonable cause to believe that the information is inaccurate. 

I also believe that the credit bureaus have violated the Fair Credit Reporting Act ( FCRA ) by failing to : 1. Investigate my disputes in a timely and reasonable manner : The credit bureaus have not provided a clear explanation for their decision not to remove the inaccurate information, and I believe their investigation was inadequate. 

2. Furnish accurate information to creditors : The inaccurate information on my credit report is harming my ability to obtain credit and other financial services.

3. Follow the FCRA 's dispute resolution procedures : The credit bureaus have failed to comply with the timeframes and procedures outlined in the FCRA. 

I am requesting that the CFPB investigate my complaint and take the following actions : 1. Order the credit bureaus to remove the inaccurate information from my credit report.

2. Require the credit bureaus to provide me with a copy of my updated credit report reflecting the changes. 

Enclosures : Copies of my dispute letters Copies of any supporting documentation I provided to the credit bureaus

I have contacted them to change my name from " XXXX '' to " XXXX '' but they have not made any changes. In XX/XX/2023 my husband ( at that time ) and I contacted Freedom Mortgage Corporation to gather information on options for him to take over the loan as we were going through a divorce, and I was the sole individual on the mortgage. The gentleman explained that my husband needed to make ( 6 ) on time mortgage payments from a bank account that only he is on. In order to show proof, he can make the payments ( he has been making on time payments for a year. ) XX/XX/2023, I received a letter from Freedom Mortage acknowledging I contacted them about an Assumption of the loan request along with the application. We completed this and a Quit Claim with his attorney. Our divorce was final in XX/XX/2023.

This day I emailed them at XXXX XXXX XXXX at their direction with the divorce papers. They sent me a letter dated XX/XX/2023, acknowledging their receival and they will review it. On XX/XX/XXXX, I contacted them as a Follow-Up at XXXX. They said it would take about ( 2 ) weeks to update and they did receive the corrected form. 

Then the 90 days process begins. I have reached out to them about three different times since then as an additional Follow-Up. I received another letter from them dated XX/XX/2023, this was also about the same time I reached out to them for an update, and they were not friendly and insisted that they have 90 days to review this. 

Each time I am told No Updates only they have 90 days to process this request. Saturday, I received and email and envelope in the mail. They sent me another ( 3rd time ) application for the Assumption Request. I contacted them today at XXXX and spoke to a " XXXX. '' I advised I needed to speak to a supervisor because there is an ongoing problem with their department losing my application/forms and it has been a year now. She insisted on keeping me on the line and refused to connect me to a supervisor. She also could not locate my paperwork. It was important to her to lecture me about the difference between sending an email request vs fax. She also advised me the 90 days does not begin until my X-husbands application process starts. That has been done. I explained multiple times to her that on XX/XX/XXXX her department confirmed they received my paperwork. Also, in the beginning of XXXX her department confirmed they have it and have 90 days to respond. " XXXX '' suddenly located my paperwork in the " XXXX XXXX '' of the documents. Whatever That Means! She then says I see your court papers are the XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX. She clearly can not read or understand what she is looking at! That is the company my X-Husband and I are employed by it has nothing to do with this application. I failure to understand why Freedom Mortgage Assumption department can not maintain my file or proper updates. 

Each person I am transferred to knows less than the previous employee did. They each give contradicting information and have been less than empathetic to this whole experience. It makes no difference to me if they approve the application or not. I simply need a letter stating one or the other in order for my X-Husband and I to know what the next move is. There is clearly something wrong with the way the Assumption department is run and organized. I certainly regret not maintaining a better timeline of dates, times and names of what each person said to me because I could have been more detailed in this frustrating experience.

If Freedom Mortgage Company failures to comply with your direction I will be seeking council and plan to take Freedom Mortgage to Civil Court. Thank You for your time.

Essentially I am running into an issue with Mohela intentionally using misleading and incorrect information to force me to pay them at a higher and non-contractual rate. I would also complaint that their issues which while it is extremely frustrating to me, is at least somewhat navigable to me while I have time, not everyone works at a desk and can wait hours to speak with the company. This should NOT be the process, and these should not be with private servicers. 
Background -- -- I have a student loan with Mohela totaling approx XXXX, previously XXXX that transferred to Mohela. During the transition my loans were on their pay program, and during the transition from REPAYE to SAVE, Mohela inputted data incorrectly and did not include my spouse 's loans, resulting in incorrect amounts being due each month. When I spoke to Mohela multiple times, they indicated they would recalculate with the correct information from the loans, and that the only change would be the amount of total loans included ( i.e. adding my spouses loan amounts ). When the loans were reviewed, my loans went from XXXX/month under repay ( correct ) to XXXX during the covid forbearance, to XXXX/month, to XXXXmonth, to XXXXmonth under the SAVE plan, ( based on total amounts, still high but at least agreeable ), and then to XXXX undera 11 leveland 1 save plan split. I will be paying the XXXX in XXXX, and while it affects XXXX, and what I can get my son, wife, and family for XXXX, its what I agreed to and I will happily pay that amount and amounts as applicable until paid off. I previously spoke to Mohela during the transition to reflect the transfer and was told they would be able to handle the change. This was incorrect, they set the monthly payment amount to XXXX, I called and indicated my spouse had loans, and Mohela indicated they would review and reprocess, this revised my monthly to an amount totaling XXXX on XX/XX/XXXX. I called and spoke to a supervisor on XX/XX/XXXX indicating that i previously had my monthly amounts under repay at XXXX and to ensure that the applications should be IDR and reflect the full amounts of loans at issue, the supervisor indicated that she entered the data from the information she had based on my XXXX data, and that everything would be OK when it was processed. And then on XX/XX/XXXX, I thought we were at least in agreement and my monthly amount was set at XXXX. This is the amount I accepted to pay until I would recertify as Married Filing Separate next year ( around XX/XX/XXXX when recertification was due ). _________ Current status After multiple discussions, multiple hour long calls and requests, on XX/XX/XXXXXXXX my loans which previously have always been income based XXXXmonth and XXXXmonth, were switched to have 1 loan be a SAVE plan loan, while each and every other one were changed to a LEVEL plan payment, totaling a monthly payment of XXXX and 11 level plans totaling which ( inclusive of XXXX ) total XXXX. This amount would mean I could not buy food, pay for my son 's school or contribute to my household in any way. 

After waiting for nearly an hour to speak with my servicer today on XX/XX/XXXX, I was told that there was an issue with my account as a previous request to include information that existed in my file, was interpreted as " to put borrower back at regular payment '' based upon my XX/XX/XXXX call to update information and review all loans based upon my complete history, XXXX, no id #, somehow processed that request and jumped to the idea that I was to be converted to a monthly payment plan without IDR included, increasing my loans from XXXX to XXXX, and removing my previous history of on time payments 1/3 of the way to loan forgiveness. 

I was subsequently told that : I could not speak to a supervisor. 
That the only solution that I had was to put in a new application. 
that " XXXX '' she has been advised we would have to go over repayment options if I disagree with the payment plan that I have been on. 
She has requested the approval to transfer to a supervisor and was advised to handle the account and procedure. 
And the agent is requiring that I submit a new application and a new rate. Further that my only option was to speak Student Aid if I wanted help, That the only possible thing that Mohela could do was to process a new application. She further indicated that she could not send a copy of the request, or the communication, or the data that went into the application because it was an internal communication. 

I need help, and I will not get it from Mohela. Please get me off of the level plan and put on the same plan that I should be on. Further, have Mohela review the XX/XX/XXXX communication from their own supervisor and the existing messages requesting help with the intent it was given, and update my application based upon the existing information currently in file with Mohela from XXXX, as indicated in my multiple calls and written communication. In the alternative, please review my monthly payment amount to the amounts set on the approval letter for XX/XX/XXXX.

On XX/XX/2023, I redeemed some of my Capital One rewards points to book a flight on XXXX XXXX. Unbeknownst to me, my action of using the benefits of the card triggered some sort of fraud warning. 

On XX/XX/2023 I tried to use my Capital One credit card to pay for dinner and it didn't work. I was embarrassed but didn't have another credit card on me. After trying the card several times, the restaurant ended up comping my dinner so I could leave. 

While walking home from dinner, I called Capital One. They let me know that they'd locked my account due to suspected fraud and I needed to upload my driver 's license, a bill with my address, and my social security card to unlock my account. 

When I got home, I couldn't find my social security card. I asked them if there was any other way I could prove my identity- my passport, my birth certificate, etc. They said that no, my social security card specifically was required. Since I don't have my social security card, I asked Capital One to transfer the points I'd earned out of my account and close it. They refused. I said ok, can I abandon all the points I've earned and just close the account. They also refused to honor my request to close my account saying that they couldn't take any action on the account while it was locked for fraud review. 

In XXXX, Capital One charged me the {$390.00} annual fee for the card. This was paid via autopay from my linked bank account. 

In XXXX, Capital One closed my account. 

I'm annoyed that : 1 ) I lost all of the points I had accumulated on the card, because Capital One ( erroneously! ) marked my account for fraud when I was just trying to use the points I had earned. 
2 ) They didn't close my account when I requested, instead waiting until the annual fee was charged ( XXXX XXXX and XXXX XXXX!!!! ) and then closing the account 3 ) I didn't get ANY value from the {$390.00} fee because since XXXX I have been unable to use my card, accumulate points, redeem points, or access any other card rewards.

I applied for SAVE on XXXX. I am currently on PAYE and was on REPAY prior. On XX/XX/XXXX I called about the processing delay. They originally claimed that my loans did not qualify for SAVE. All of my student loans are direct loans and this information was simply not true. After further pushing as to the reason why my application had not been processed, they informed that that my application was declined for missing information ( which they never notified me about ) and require 3 years of tax returns to re-process the application. I referred to the Federal Register update 685.209 ( e ) from XX/XX/XXXX that eliminated the previous years income requirement. The rep insisted that this is just required and that the government has to know how much money I made during nonpayment ( even though I file and pay taxes every year ) and could not tell me why. I have never received in writing why my application was declined or what information was " missing ''. I later recontacted them again on XX/XX/XXXX and pushed for supervisor who assured me that my application would be processed within 2-3 weeks and that the tax return requirement was in fact, not required. 

As of XX/XX/XXXX, my next payment is due on XX/XX/XXXX and they still have not processed my application and their stated reason is that they are " behind '', even though I have been speaking with peers with applications submitted after mine that have already been approved. My choices presented to me by the phone rep was to pay the monthly payment ( that I can't afford ) or extend my forbearance. They continue to ignore my application while my loans gather interest. It is incredibly unfair that I have to continue to accrue interest that will be capitalized because of their inability to perform the most basic of their job functions. It feels predatory that the ineptitude of a company can contribute to my student loan debt. Why should they do anything in a timely manner if they benefit from it financially? 

Mohela clearly does not have the necessary staff knowledge to appropriately service loans. They can not be bothered to keep up with current/up to date rules and requirements. There is no consistency. Every time I speak with a representative ( after hours on hold ), I am told something different or a vague explanation.

I then set up the payee and a payment, a single payment, for that same {$3700.00} to pay off my XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX The card is managed by XXXX XXXX for XXXX XXXX. When I set up the payee the default name was " XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX '', clearly very generic so I changed it to " XXXX XXXX XXXX ''. I have email confirmations of each of those events. 

The payment date was supposed to be the XXXX of XX/XX/2023. On the XXXX of XXXX I received an email stating the payment has been refused by the bank as the funding account was closed. The email also stated that " as a courtesy '' the payment was covered. This was not the case, obviously, so I called PenFed to find out what was going on and the lady I spoke with confirmed the account was open and funded with enough funds to cover the payment. She then recommended I give it a few days to let what was obviously a system hiccup sort out. I then received another email stating that since they were unable to complete an electronic withdrawal from my funding account the bill pay funding account was blocked. I re-established the bill pay on the XXXX of XXXX and withing seconds got another email stating the account had been deleted. 

When calling to get information and to have this sorted out I found that TWO payments of {$3700.00} were made to my credit card company, even though I only scheduled one, so now my account was in the negative, - {$2900.00} to be exact. I spoke with very nice people on the phone and had repeated emails with an ineffective condescending XXXX named XXXX XXXX XXXX full last name not provided ) under Case # XXXX. I tried to explain that I only scheduled one payment and that it was to payoff the card balance so it would make NO sense for me to schedule two payments. I repeated frequently that this was a PenFed mix-up and asked for them to provide system logs to prove their assumption that this was my mistake. What XXXX did provide ( attached ) was an image easily falsifiable in XXXX  or XXXX that was incorrect as it shows a scheduled payment to XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX created on XX/XX/XXXX, not to XXXX XXXX XXXX as I did. But they do show creation of a payment to XXXX XXXX XXXX on the XXXX, the day the payment was supposed to be made! Further I gave the XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX default name a nickname the day I set them up as a payee. And I wasn't even in the system on the XXXX to schedule a payment. So they made a fraudulent payment ( one not set up or authorized by me ) and further one that should have been refused to begin with if it took my accounts into the negative. They have deleted the checking account and the debit card tied to it, blocking my access to it and the bill pay functionality which prevents me from having access to any account information to prove my case. They further will not provide any proof in the form of system logs or call recordings that demonstrate, contrary to my assertions, that I did in fact schedule/request two payments. 

So after a week of nonsense from PenFed refusing to correct the mistake they made I called XXXX XXXX credit card customer service and requested a refund of the negative balance ( credit amount ) back to the account that created this credit amount. I am including a picture of my credit card account page showing the duplicate payments and negative balance. They said it could take up to XXXX business days. I then called PenFed, I believe XX/XX/XXXX, and told them I fixed their screw-up and that the refund could take up to 17 days. Not 100 % sure about the date as I've had a LOT of calls to and from PenFed the past couple weeks. 

Fast forward to XX/XX/XXXX and I receive a letter in the mail stating that if I didn't bring the account positive in 10 days they would close my accounts, my credit card, my home loan and HELOC because they have made multiple attempts to contact me. Oh, and they were graciously not going to access a fee for my account going negative. Yes and I very clearly had already called to let them know what was going on so they clearly don't read account notes. 

So they should be investigated for performing fraudulent account activity with end user accounts that were not initiated nor authorized by the account holder. It XXXX to be in this position and feel betrayed by a XXXX XXXX that purports to be supportive of XXXX XXXX like me ( veteran ) and their families. If they just owned up to the fact that it was their mistake it would feel less skeezy on their part.

XXXX reports that due to the guidelines set by the Department of Education, since MOHELA is the current servicer, that MOHELA is responsible for the refund of the payments. 

Every time I contact XXXX, I am given different information. On XX/XX/XXXXXXXX  I called to follow up on my email request for the refund. I was told that they did not receive my email. I told the representative that I have a copy of the email in my sent folder and the representative instructed me to forward it to their contact email address again.

XXXX agreed that it was an error and reported that he could see my payment history and that I should be refunded much more than that. XXXX stated that he would conduct an investigation and contact me. 

On XX/XX/XXXXXXXX  XXXX called me and stated that according their guidelines from the Department of Education, Mohela must pay. I requested written or online verification of his statement and he told me that it was probably internal and could not share it with me. 

On XXXX XXXX, XXXX, I uploaded a copy of my email request for a refund to my Mohela account to again request a refund. Thank you for your help, Sincerely, XXXX

I received a mortgage in 2002 from countrywide home loans. I am aware of the securitization scheme and the mortgage was sold several times without my consent or knowledge. The mortgage then went into foreclosure and I was not given full disclosure and i suffered much injury loss and damage that has been life threatening to my livelihood. I sent XXXX XXXX indenture trustee all the information regarding the foreclosure along with a XXXX and an international bill of exchange along with the deed to my property. XXXX XXXX is in breach of the trust and never returned back to me my securities I sent them. 
I now remain homeless and I am still yet to receive compensation. 
This is the letter I sent : XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX. 

Countrywide Home Loans XXXX XXXX XXXX Texas XXXX Defendant This notice is regarding account No. XXXX XXXX to the foreclosure on the home at XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX, Kentucky XXXX that is admitting that you possessed the note. Its an admission that the bank has the obligation to perform. By foreclosing you accepted a security, its rights of recourse are XXXX under the XXXX XXXX, XXXX, and XXXX, and therefore the bank owes me. i hold the security interest in the note. ( my credit ) i hold the security interest in the mortgage too. 
The bank entered it as a debit to their assets-meaning an increase in assets. 
XXXX XXXX XXXX, i signed the mortgage it's my security. You have an obligation to perform on the security by exchanging it for equal value. 
Is it the banks policy to transfer actual cash value from the alleged borrower to the bank and then return it back as a loan, knowing the bank received the funds from the alleged borrower for free to transfer actual cash value from the alleged borrower to the bank and then keep the funds as the banks property. Was it the banks intent to receive actual cash value from the borrower? 
You have breached written agreements and the use of false and misleading advertising act without written permission to authorization and without the borrower 's knowledge. 
By having failed to return the securities or give me equal value such as release of the mortgage, you have committed SECURITIES AND TAX FRAUD. The books will show you never paid taxes on the gain. Where is my value? Show me the tax forms that declared it at a taxable gain since you've construed that i abandoned the property. 
You need to show cause that you do not have an interest in my property. 
Acquiescence is consent. 
You are in a XXXX breach. 
i am giving you the opportunity to cure this error by compensating me XXXX XXXX dollars for the injury damage and loss you have caused me and access to the securities, proceeds, interest, dividends where my note has been monetized, securalized and sold on the international stock market. 
You have 3 days from receiving this notice to remedy this matter and perform on my behalf for my benefit. 
If you ignore this notice i will then start the lawful criminal action proceeding and i will inform the general post master to investigate along with a full forensic audit by the IRS. 


Done in good faith XXXX Rights XXXX

Dave bank has done an abysmal job handling the disputes I filed against two fraudulent transactions, and this needs to be escalated so they don't continue to XXXX over their customers. 
In early XXXX I attempted to file a dispute against XXXX  fraudulent transactions made without my knowledge, consent, or authorization on my Dave debit card/checking account. Dave is quite literally impossible to get a hold of, and I was blatantly ignored, hung up on, and rerouted without assistance numerous times in the process of trying to get them to properly open these disputes- there is no way to do this in the app/without contacting a representative. 
On XX/XX/XXXX Dave finally acknowledged/opened a dispute against these XXXX  transactions, which were : 1. XXXX - " XXXX, XXXX, XXXX  '' on Sat, XX/XX/XXXX, in the amount of {$500.00} 2. " XXXX XXXX XXXX, XXXX, XXXX  '' on Sat, XX/XX/XXXX, in the amount of {$220.00} I provided all of the required information asked for - like social security number, and general dispute questions- via email to Dave, and on XX/XX/XXXX they confirmed that " I have submitted your claim as of XX/XX/XXXX. The dispute team will review your case and notify you within 10 business days if the transaction is eligible for a provisional credit. '' They also mentioned that : " You will receive a separate email communication with further details of your dispute claim. If we do not receive the necessary documentation, the claim is ineligible for a provisional credit and you will need to wait up to 90 days for final resolution. Please be on the lookout in your inbox ( or spam ) for that email. '' I did not hear anything further until XX/XX/XXXX, when I received the following email : " You recently contacted us to initiate a dispute. We have determined that additional information is needed from you. 
Please contact us within 7 calendar days if you would like to proceed with the claim. 
Without additional information, we will not be able to proceed with the dispute, and we will consider this matter resolved. 
We look forward to a resolution as quickly as possible. '' The " contact us '' portion was underlined and when clicked, was linked to the " Disputing a transaction in your Dave Spending account '' page at the following URL - https : //support.dave.com/hc/en-us/articles/5229546038029-Disputing-a-transaction-on-your-Dave-Spending-account? lid=ck5s1zkvxcq1 This page is not a " contact us '' page and provides no information about how I am supposed to reach out to Dave or what, quote, " additional information '' I am supposed to supply in order for them to " proceed with the claim. '' So on XX/XX/XXXX, I immediately emailed Dave with the following : " Hey there, I received the following email : 'You recently contacted us to initiate a dispute. We have determined that additional information is needed from you.

Please contact us within 7 calendar days if you would like to proceed with the claim. 
Without additional information, we will not be able to proceed with the dispute, and we will consider this matter resolved. ' Clearly I intend to have a dispute filed for these transactions. I already answered 100 % of the questions you asked to file this dispute. Since then, Ive received no further contact at all - no requests for any information of any kind - up until the above email. Obviously I need you to proceed with the dispute, which is why I followed it in the first place. Please do your job. '' The XX/XX/XXXX automated email asking for " additional information '' to proceed provided no instructions on where to reach out or with WHAT information, so I was utterly confused at what I needed to do. 

In response to my XX/XX/XXXX email, on XX/XX/XXXX I receive : " Hi XXXX, I understand that you're worried and looking for an update on your dispute. I reviewed your account and this is what happened. 
Your claim that you've submitted on XX/XX/XXXX is currently being investigated. Heres what happens next : Your can expect an update on your dispute by XX/XX/XXXX or the 10th business day. 
If we require more time to review your dispute, a Provisional Credit may be provided to you by the 10th business day ( 20th business day for new accounts ). 
Please note, it may take up to 90 calendar days to fully investigate your dispute. You will be notified if we need additional time. 
Once weve completed our investigation : We will inform you of the results within 3 business days of completing our investigation. 
If we conclude there was no error we will also send you a written explanation. Please note, if we conclude no error has occurred any provisional credit you were provided may be rescinded, we will inform you of the date and the amount of the debit. 
We appreciate your patience as we continue our investigation. '' To this I responded on XX/XX/XXXX : " Hello, I didn't ask for an update on my dispute. 
YOU guys emailed me with the following : XXXXcopy of the XX/XX/XXXX emailXXXX  OBVIOUSLY this email states I need to write in and request that the dispute be continued/to proceed with the claim. It states " additional information '' is needed, but does NOT specify what the XXXX that " additional information '' is. Please ACTUALLY read this email instead of giving another irrelevant canned response. '' On XX/XX/XXXX Dave responds with : " Hi XXXX, May I know when did you received this email?

I'll patiently wait your response. '' To which I say : " Yes, I received that email on XX/XX/XXXX, and for the XXXX  TIME, the screenshot is very clearly FROM YOU GUYS, claiming I needed to respond because my claim hadn't been processed and needed my response to proceed. 
I should already have received a provisional credit for these two transactions by now, and yet you guys still haven't done that. You guys can't even keep track of your own disputes process nor the emails you send. I'm starting to feel like Dave is a scam at worst, at best extremely unprofessional and mismanaged. '' Finally on XX/XX/XXXX I get some form of information. Dave replies with : " Hi XXXX, We appreciate you for getting back to us. 
It looks like our dispute team reached out to you to request additional information via email and are awaiting your response. 
Please check your Email and find the form/additional need information that our team sent to you. 
Then please attach and send the completed form/needed information to XXXX so our team can review your information. This may qualify you for provisional credit. 
We appreciate your patience while we are investigating your dispute. 
" However, Dave did not attach any form to that email, and of course I NEVER received any form via email, just the XX/XX/XXXX email requesting " additional information '' with no instructions or clarifications as to WHAT that information was. 

So I respond : " Hey there, No, you didnt. 
I have now sent the email I got from you guys XXXX  TIMES and you people STILL cant do your jobs properly. 
You never sent me any form. 
You sent me an email claiming I needed to respond and tell you to proceed with the claim so it could be kept open. I did that XXXX  TIMES NOW. 
You never sent a form. And by now a provisional credit legally needs to have been issued - still havent done that either. '' It takes them until XX/XX/XXXX to send me the form I need to fill out - titled " XXXX XXXX' I immediately fill this out and email it back to them. They confirm they received it on XX/XX/XXXX. 

On XX/XX/XXXX : " Hi XXXX I understand that you've already sent the filed out form of supporting documents. I was able to find information for you. 
Our dispute department will be updating you regarding the status of your transaction dispute and your provisional credit if eligible. 
We recommend to monitor your email from time to time for the notification from the dispute department. '' Then radio silence from Dave. I write into their customer service via chat, and the agent dodges my questions with irrelevant canned responses. She claims that I am not eligible for a provisional credit because I didn't send in the form ... That they confirmed I received on XX/XX/XXXX. I repeat that I did, and have evidence they confirmed receipt of this form. She keeps asking me " when did you send in the dispute form, you are eligible for credit XXXX days after that form '' and is impossible to talk to, with all the reading comprehension of a robot. 
So I email Dave on XX/XX/XXXX after continuing to receive no responses, XXXX  month from when they confirmed they opened my disputes. 

" Why has there been no update on this? I filed this dispute on XX/XX/XXXX, it's been A MONTH since then, and STILL no provisional credit- which is highly illegal on your part. I sent this ridiculous form on XX/XX/XXXX, it is now XX/XX/XXXX, STILL NO PROVISIONAL CREDIT and STILL ZERO COMMUNICATION from you guys. I'm opening a CFPB complaint and if you guys don't issue a provisional credit and handle this properly soon I'll be filing an arbitration demand. '' Today on XX/XX/XXXX, Dave claims that : " XXXX XXXX, Thank you for reaching Dave support. I'm a supervisor here at Dave, and will assist you moving forward. 
We are sorry to hear that you haven't received an update yet but sure I can certainly give you an update on your recent dispute. 
Our Dispute department has determined that this type of dispute is not eligible for provisional credit. 
Your claim will be finalized within 90 days from the date you submitted your dispute XX/XX/XXXX. 
We will send you communication by mail or email with the final resolution. '' I am absolutely furious and sick of getting the run around from Dave. I have only filed a few disputes in my life- with other banks- and the process was NOTHING like this. I was issued a provisional credit immediately, or at least within 10 business days, and communicate was clear and consistent.

Dave has dodged responsibility for this at every attempt for me to gain clarification on the process, and I believe they are operating in illegal and frankly immoral ways.

My understanding of EFTA Reg E is that a provisional credit should have been issued by now. I do not see how Dave can claim I am ineligible for a credit when I've done *everything* they've asked and filled out the form they claimed would grant me a provisional credit. I don't see how it's legal for Dave to deny me a credit - and not provide any documentation to me to support their reasoning for denying this credit - but also claim it'll take UP TO 90 DAYS to investigate these fraudulent transactions. 
I can not go without access to these funds for ANOTHER 90 DAYS and I shouldn't legally have to. Dave allowed fraud to take place on my account and needs to make this right immediately.

" [redacted], [redacted], [redacted] '' on sat, [redacted], in the amount of {$220.00} i provided all of the required information asked for - like social security number, and general dispute questions- via email to dave, and on [redacted] they confirmed that " i have submitted your claim as of [redacted]. the dispute team will review your case and notify you within 10 business days if the transaction is eligible for a provisional credit. '' they also mentioned that : " you will receive a separate email communication with further details of your dispute claim. if we do not receive the necessary documentation, the claim is ineligible for a provisional credit and you will need to wait up to 90 days for final resolution. please be on the lookout in your inbox ( or spam ) for that email. '' i did not hear anything further until [redacted], when i received the following email : " you recently contacted us to initiate a dispute. we have determined that additional information is needed from you. please contact us within 7 calendar days if you would like to proceed with the claim. without additional information, we will not be able to proceed with the dispute, and we will consider this matter resolved. we look forward to a resolution as quickly as possible. '' the " contact us '' portion was underlined and when clicked, was linked to the " disputing a transaction in your dave spending account '' page at the following url - https : //support.dave.com/hc/en-us/articles/5229546038029-disputing-a-transaction-on-your-dave-spending-account? lid=ck5s1zkvxcq1 this page is not a " contact us '' page and provides no information about how i am supposed to reach out to dave or what, quote, " additional information '' i am supposed to supply in order for them to " proceed with the claim. '' so on [redacted], i immediately emailed dave with the following : " hey there, i received the following email : 'you recently contacted us to initiate a dispute. we have determined that additional information is needed from you. please contact us within 7 calendar days if you would like to proceed with the claim. without additional information, we will not be able to proceed with the dispute, and we will consider this matter resolved. ' clearly i intend to have a dispute filed for these transactions. i already answered 100 % of the questions you asked to file this dispute. since then, ive received no further contact at all - no requests for any information of any kind - up until the above email. obviously i need you to proceed with the dispute, which is why i followed it in the first place. please do your job. '' the [redacted] automated email asking for " additional information '' to proceed provided no instructions on where to reach out or with what information, so i was utterly confused at what i needed to do. in response to my [redacted] email, on [redacted] i receive : " hi [redacted], i understand that you're worried and looking for an update on your dispute. i reviewed your account and this is what happened. your claim that you've submitted on [redacted] is currently being investigated. heres what happens next : your can expect an update on your dispute by [redacted] or the 10th business day. if we require more time to review your dispute, a provisional credit may be provided to you by the 10th business day ( 20th business day for new accounts ). please note, it may take up to 90 calendar days to fully investigate your dispute. you will be notified if we need additional time. once weve completed our investigation : we will inform you of the results within 3 business days of completing our investigation. if we conclude there was no error we will also send you a written explanation. please note, if we conclude no error has occurred any provisional credit you were provided may be rescinded, we will inform you of the date and the amount of the debit. we appreciate your patience as we continue our investigation. '' to this i responded on [redacted] : " hello, i didn't ask for an update on my dispute. you guys emailed me with the following : xxxxcopy of the [redacted] emailxxxx obviously this email states i need to write in and request that the dispute be continued/to proceed with the claim. it states " additional information '' is needed, but does not specify what the [redacted] that " additional information '' is. please actually read this email instead of giving another irrelevant canned response. '' on [redacted] dave responds with : " hi [redacted], may i know when did you received this email? i'll patiently wait your response. '' to which i say : " yes, i received that email on [redacted], and for the [redacted] time, the screenshot is very clearly from you guys, claiming i needed to respond because my claim hadn't been processed and needed my response to proceed. i should already have received a provisional credit for these two transactions by now, and yet you guys still haven't done that. you guys can't even keep track of your own disputes process nor the emails you send. i'm starting to feel like dave is a scam at worst, at best extremely unprofessional and mismanaged. '' finally on [redacted] i get some form of information. dave replies with : " hi [redacted], we appreciate you for getting back to us. it looks like our dispute team reached out to you to request additional information via email and are awaiting your response. please check your email and find the form/additional need information that our team sent to you. then please attach and send the completed form/needed information to [redacted] so our team can review your information. this may qualify you for provisional credit. we appreciate your patience while we are investigating your dispute. " however, dave did not attach any form to that email, and of course i never received any form via email, just the [redacted] email requesting " additional information '' with no instructions or clarifications as to what that information was. so i respond : " hey there, no, you didnt. i have now sent the email i got from you guys [redacted] times and you people still cant do your jobs properly. you never sent me any form. you sent me an email claiming i needed to respond and tell you to proceed with the claim so it could be kept open. i did that [redacted] times now. you never sent a form. and by now a provisional credit legally needs to have been issued - still havent done that either. '' it takes them until [redacted] to send me the form i need to fill out - titled " [redacted]' i immediately fill this out and email it back to them. they confirm they received it on [redacted]. on [redacted] : " hi [redacted] i understand that you've already sent the filed out form of supporting documents. i was able to find information for you. our dispute department will be updating you regarding the status of your transaction dispute and your provisional credit if eligible. we recommend to monitor your email from time to time for the notification from the dispute department. '' then radio silence from dave. i write into their customer service via chat, and the agent dodges my questions with irrelevant canned responses. she claims that i am not eligible for a provisional credit because i didn't send in the form ... that they confirmed i received on [redacted]. i repeat that i did, and have evidence they confirmed receipt of this form. she keeps asking me " when did you send in the dispute form, you are eligible for credit [redacted] days after that form '' and is impossible to talk to, with all the reading comprehension of a robot. so i email dave on [redacted] after continuing to receive no responses, [redacted] month from when they confirmed they opened my disputes. " why has there been no update on this? i filed this dispute on [redacted], it's been a month since then, and still no provisional credit- which is highly illegal on your part. i sent this ridiculous form on [redacted], it is now [redacted], still no provisional credit and still zero communication from you guys. i'm opening a cfpb complaint and if you guys don't issue a provisional credit and handle this properly soon i'll be filing an arbitration demand. '' today on [redacted], dave claims that : " [redacted], thank you for reaching dave support. i'm a supervisor here at dave, and will assist you moving forward. we are sorry to hear that you haven't received an update yet but sure i can certainly give you an update on your recent dispute. our dispute department has determined that this type of dispute is not eligible for provisional credit. your claim will be finalized within 90 days from the date you submitted your dispute [redacted]. we will send you communication by mail or email with the final resolution. '' i am absolutely furious and sick of getting the run around from dave. i have only filed a few disputes in my life- with other banks- and the process was nothing like this. i was issued a provisional credit immediately, or at least within 10 business days, and communicate was clear and consistent. dave has dodged responsibility for this at every attempt for me to gain clarification on the process, and i believe they are operating in illegal and frankly immoral ways. my understanding of efta reg e is that a provisional credit should have been issued by now. i do not see how dave can claim i am ineligible for a credit when i've done *everything* they've asked and filled out the form they claimed would grant me a provisional credit. i don't see how it's legal for dave to deny me a credit - and not provide any documentation to me to support their reasoning for denying this credit - but also claim it'll take up to 90 days to investigate these fraudulent transactions. i can not go without access to these funds for another 90 days and i shouldn't legally have to. dave allowed fraud to take place on my account and needs to make this right immediately.

text_raw:
My mortgage was sold off to Rushmore Loan Management Services while I was struggling to stay current with payments. After working with a community non profit, they were able to help me with the past due balance and the mortgage was brought current in XXXX. At this time, the loan was transferred to Rushmore Servicing, another company under the XXXX XXXX conglomerate. I called at the end of XXXX to verify how I would be making payments. I spoke to a representative who said that they could not access my account yet because it was still being migrated to their system and this process could take a couple weeks. I raised my concern about getting hit with late fees, but the rep assured me that no late fees would be assessed in the first XXXX  days of transfer. 

Towards the end of XXXX I tried to access the Rushmore Servicing website and found out they had been the target of a hack. Approximately a week later, access to their website was restored and I was able to create an account. I called Rushmore again around the middle of XXXX to get clarification on a fee that was not explained on my statement. Towards the end of the conversation, the rep asked if I wanted to start a loan modification application. I was extremely clear that I did not want anything to change with my loan at all. Do not start an application, do not touch my mortgage, I do not want anything to change. Interest rates have been increasing and they are pushing low rate loans into these loan modifications. I submitted a payment for the entire balance due after this phone call. 

Considering the experience I've had so far with this company, I was checking on my account regularly to ensure these payments were posted properly. Instead of applying it to my loan based on the current payments, they applied it as if I had accepted the trial plan for the loan modification that I never wanted. Yesterday I logged into my account to see they have been pushing me through a loan modification process that I never initiated and firmly refused when they brought it up the first time in XXXX. I have screenshots showing that an application was started and that application was received by them. I called today to request the application documentation that was submitted. Initially I spoke to someone from a call center located overseas, but requested to speak to a supervisor and I was transferred to a rep located in XXXX. This representative stated that the loan modification was automatically processed despite me stating that I did not want anything to be changed with the mortgage. At this time she said she was going to research my payments and she would put me on a brief hold. That was XXXX minutes ago. This company makes it extremely difficult to speak to anyone and when you finally do get through, they leave you on hold and never come back to address anything. I did not choose to do business with this company and yet I'm forced to because my mortgage was sold to them. Telling me XXXX thing, then doing exactly what they said they wouldn't. Submitting applications to change loans without the consent of the borrower seems like it should be illegal. Now I have to worry that they will do other fraudulent activities which could result in misapplied payments, late fees, etc.

This morning [ XX/XX/XXXX at XXXX XXXX  ], I noticed on the BOA app that my Bank of America Travel Rewards Credit Card has been changed to the Bank of America Unlimited Cash Rewards Visa Signature credit card. Both of these cards have {$0.00} annual fee. On their website, it states that the travel card has no foreign transaction fee, whereas the unlimited cash rewards card has a 3 % foreign transaction fee. 
I have received countless offers to switch my travel card to the unlimited cash card and I never authorized this change. 
My last transaction made on this credit card was on XX/XX/XXXX, almost 2 years ago. I suspected this change might be targeted to less active accounts like mine, similar to their unauthorized account openings scheme. 
I called customer support about this issue and the support agent told me there was a notice that was sent to me on XX/XX/XXXX notifying me of this change. However, in this notice, supposedly, there was no option to opt out of it. I do not see any such notice on my online account, where I should have a digital copy of all notices that are physically mailed to me.

He looked into my account and saw that my specific account doesnt have foreign transaction fees and this was part of the complementary change to honor the no foreign transaction fees on my old card. 
I asked to have my card switched back to the travel card since I never authorized this change. He read the disclosure about accounts and offers becoming invalid. Wanting more time to think about this, I asked for documentation to be sent and he said he can send the documentation specific to my account. However, his only option is to send it via physical mail and it should arrive in XXXX weeks.

Consumer Financial Protection Bureau XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX  XXXX, Iowa XXXX Subject : Complaint Against Comenity Capital Bank 's Predatory Practices Dear Sir/Madam , I write to lodge a formal complaint against Comenity Capital Bank for what I perceive to be their predatory business practices, especially concerning their credit card promotions. This experience has not only caused me financial duress but has also made me deeply concerned about the broader implications of such practices on unsuspecting consumers. 

On XX/XX/XXXX, I made a purchase of {$1200.00} from XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX  using Comenity Bank 's Payboo Card promotion, which promised zero interest for 12 months. Relying on their terms and believing in their transparency, I set up an automatic monthly payment of {$100.00}. As of XX/XX/XXXX, my remaining balance was a mere {$53.00}. To my shock, Comenity Bank levied an interest charge of {$170.00} on this balance, an action that feels not only exploitative but also deceptive. 

Key Issues : Lack of Communication : Despite the looming interest accrual, there was no prior communication - be it a paper bill, an email, a text, or even a simple phone call, to alert me of this impending charge. 

Predatory Promotion Terms : The terms and conditions associated with the promotion are designed in a manner that seems intended to trap consumers. While businesses have the right to earn interest on overdue amounts, the sheer magnitude and method of this interest application, particularly when the outstanding amount was so minimal, is hard to view as anything other than predatory. 

Public Evidence : A brief review of the XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX page for Comenity Capital Bank reveals a pattern of complaints, underscoring the systematic nature of these issues : XXXX  Comenity Bank Complaint Page. 

Requested Actions : Full Refund : I urge the CFPB to intervene and compel Comenity Capital Bank to refund the {$170.00} interest charge in full. 

Transparent Communication Mandate : The bank should be obligated to provide clear and timely communication about any upcoming charges or changes, especially those with potential financial penalties. 

Regulation of Promotional Terms : Such misleading promotional terms should be scrutinized, regulated, and if found predatory, removed to ensure a fair consumer environment. 

In the interest of all consumers and in pursuit of transparency and fairness in financial transactions, I implore the CFPB to thoroughly investigate this matter. The public deserves protection against practices that seem designed to exploit, and institutions like Comenity Bank should be held accountable for their actions. 

I trust the CFPB to take the necessary measures in this regard and ensure that consumers like myself can engage in financial transactions without fear of hidden pitfalls or exploitation. 

Thank you for your time and attention to this matter. 

Warm regards, XXXX

The house, located at XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX in XXXX NJ. XXXX, was purchased in XX/XX/XXXX. Shortly after, the mortgage company was changed to Caliber Home Loans. Monthly payments were being made and there were no issues with the mortgage or the taxes until XXXX. I was made aware of an increase with the mortgage when I contacted Caliber Home Loans to explore refinancing options. It was then I was informed that I could not refinance the home because there was an issue with the taxes on the home. I contacted the City of XXXX New Jersey, since the house is located that city. I spoke to the tax collector, and he informed me that he was not aware of the issue. He proceeded to reach out to the tax assessor XXXX XXXX. Immediately after hearing the house address, XXXX XXXX stated that he is aware of an issue, and he is working to rectify it. XXXX XXXX then went on to explain what occurred, which I did not comprehend. Anyhow, I was assured that the issue would be addressed, and the mortgage company would be reimbursed for the over charged taxes. Several weeks when by and each time I contacted XXXX XXXX, I was informed that the issue is still not addressed. Eventually, I reached out to the city council member for the area where the house is located to enlist assistance to resolve this issue. The city council members held an emergency meeting, and a referendum was passed clearing the way to begin the process to reimburse Caliber Home Loans. 
The check in the amount of $ XXXX dollar was sent to Caliber Home Loans and for several weeks and possibly months after the check was cashed by Caliber Home Loans, they claimed they never received the check. Thus, the beginning of constantly calling Caliber Home Loan followed by financial hardship and the house being placed into foreclosure. 
It was identified that the check was cashed in XXXX of XXXX, however, my account was not credited, even though I continued to make the monthly mortgage payment. I spent countless hours calling Caliber Home Loans pleading with them to explain what was going on with the account and the money was reimbursed. Each time I called ; each representative provided a different explanation. In XX/XX/XXXX, I spoke with a manager, and she informed me that the money was applied to the account and as of XXXX of XXXX, the account would be updated and there would be no outstanding balance. In addition, she promised to mail the information that would reflect the updated account, but that never happened. Prior to my conversation with the manager, every representative I spoke to promised to escalate my concerns and they each promised to call with an update, but that never happened. As expected, I was frustrated, and I kept calling and kept getting different answers and the amount that was outstanding changed every time the mortgage company was contacted. 
I hired a lawyer, but the results were not in our favor. The lawyer wanted the me and my mom to take out a second mortgage to satisfy the outstanding balance, but that recommendation was not accepted. Instead, my mom took out a loan in excess of {$25000.00} to pay what was allegedly owed to avoid foreclosure. 
In the meantime, our credit scores were dropping, and I was denied accesses to credit. There were countless calls from collection agencies. 
Eventually, Caliber Home Loans sold the mortgage to XXXXXXXX XXXX and the issue continued to the point where XXXXXXXX XXXX stopped collecting the monthly payments and placed the home in foreclosure. As previously mentioned, my mom took out a loan to pay the outstanding balance, since both of us did not want the lose the house.

I believe they are sending out these emails in hopes that some customers will double pay them.

On or about XXXX or XXXX 2023 I logged on to my mortgage site, Mrcooper.com, to check to make sure my payment was scheduled to come out on XX/XX/2023. I immediately encountered a big red banner explaining Mrcooper was under a cyber attack as of XX/XX/2023 and the site was locked for security. A link was provided and on the FAQ was a statement that when ACH payments would resume MrCooper would notify customers. On XX/XX/XXXX {$2200.00} was taken from my checking account under the NSM DBA MRCOOPER name. Mr Cooper customer service can not verify that the payment was received by them. Therefore I have no idea whether they received it or the cyber criminal has. They also provided me with a link to file a complaint with them ( www.mrcooper.com/legal/complaints ) then after filling the customer " ticket '' and clicking submit it will not accept the " ticket '' because the site is shut down. 
Also I would not have even known that the company was under an attack unless I logged on... no email or phone call was ever received by me. 
I do not understand how the company can go ahead and process transactions with having a secure way to confirm payments received.

l appealed a recent Loss Mitigation disapproval from Flagstar Bank based on the fact that after completing a 12 month forbearance plan due to XXXX XXXX  and the death of a spouse I applied for my 1st loss mitigation plan a few months ago of which I was approved and completely complied with by completing the 3 months of trial payments and a XXXX payment this XX/XX/2023 and because I did not receive the final documents to finalize the loan modification due to my loan documents being left on my front porch by XXXX I was informed by Flagstar Bank that the original plan that I was approved for was cancelled and that I would have to restart the entire loss mitigation program all over again which I felt was very unfair based on the fact that I did fully comply with the terms of the original plan that was given to me in making the required trial payments and due to no fault of my own did not receive the fedex packet of information to finalize the previously authorized and granted loan modification. 

After submitting a XXXX loan modification request foreclosure proceedings were suddenly started on my home without my knowledge due to nonreceipt of additional loan information that Flagstar Bank never informed me that was needed until after they had actually started the foreclosure proceedings. 

I requested an appeal of Flagstar 's most recent disapproval decision based on the following : 1 - I did comply with and satisfied the requirements of the original loss mitigation plan per Flagstar Bank 's request by completing the 3 months of trial required payments per that plan in a very timely and exemplary manner and my previous loan modification was APPROVED and then cancelled after the receipt of XXXX payments because I did not receive the loan finalization documents from Flagstar Bank. 

2 - My 2nd loan modification was disapproved due to nonreceipt of information that I was never informed that was needed by Flagstar Bank to complete the application.

Mr. Cooper has not disclosed information to me in a timely manner about what information was compromised and how it was compromised. Not only is my family a victim of crime from the criminals we are also suffering at the hands of those " trusted agents '' that are selling our data points and PII to assist big data and in the process opening up several attack vectors causing undue harm through their negligence.

( 7 ) The right to proceedings free from unreasonable delay.

This is a secondary complaint for the balance of another gift card I received from my work at the beginning of XXXX. 
Since having been activated on XX/XX/XXXX, the card has worked a total of two times, permitting for less than 20 % of the balance to be used over the course of almost a year. After attempting transactions multiple times over the course of several months, the card was finally successfully used for a single transaction in-person at XXXX on XX/XX/XXXXXXXX  and a second time at XXXX on XX/XX/XXXX. 
Besides these two successful transactions, I have attempted to use the card multiple times without success - I had a XXXX pickup transaction that was initially processed successfully, the item arrived at the store for pickup, and the card then retroactively declined when I arrived to pickup. This resulted in me having to pay with an actual credit card for a charge I had not planned for based on the initial approval. I have had customer service agents attempt to manually process the card after initial declines at the terminal, only for the card to still get declined. I have been unable to replicate successful transactions in-person at XXXX, or XXXX, despite the card having worked once at each store. 
The card is virtually useless online, and get 's rejected summarily by every website I have attempted to use it on. It is, furthermore, stressfully unreliable for in-person transactions. There seems to be no rhyme or reason to why transactions are declined, and customer service agents are unable to provide any actual reason beyond " safety '' for the inability to use the card for any sort of transaction. The inability to process transactions seemingly violates everything that is advertised - forget about adding them to digital wallets ( doesn't work ), forget about using them for online transactions ( also doesn't work ), and forget about using them for in-person shopping ( basically doesn't work ). 
I am holding out hope for a similar resolution to my first complaint so I can end this saga, and promptly reject them as gifts moving forward. Personally, I am an avid proponent of American Express and they're many credit card offerings. I'm not sure where the ball is being dropped on these gift cards, but it's extremely disappointing.
